title: Boltz-2 CPU Execution and Diagnostic Boundaries: A Windows 11 Technical Record
description: A bounded Technical Record of two fixed Boltz-2 v2.2.1 CPU inference attempts on a personal Windows 11 computer with approximately 16 GiB RAM. Both the standard attempt and the chunking-enabled attempt ended MEMORY_STOP, without a successful final structure or confidence output. The archive provides the English README, two figures, three main tables, curated historical logs, provenance, corrections and offline read-only verification code. Isolated operator and test-only numerical checks, synthetic traces and a 96 MiB Windows small-worker regression provide limited evidence only. Real-model stage diagnostics were not run; the final feasibility decision was NO-GO / research STOP. Successful inference, end-to-end memory reduction, full-model numerical equivalence, real-model safety and independent scientific MSC are not established.
